blocks.content: Before proceeding further, it is important to remember that you need to supply the full path of the file to the open() function if your .cpp file and your .txt file are in different directories.
We only used my_file.open("message.txt"); because our main.cpp file was in the same directory as message.txt.

blocks.alt: The cpp file is inside the same folder as the text file. So, we don't need to specify the full file path.
